verdicts.reason: Both crop the photo to just a mouth and cheek, so the face (the original's key image) is lost and the result reads as a shrunk crop. The headline is small for a banner in both, and the molecule is cut off at the right edge. A at least groups the bulb, atom and question-mark doodles next to the text block. In B the question-mark doodle lands on the subject's mouth, an unwanted collision. B's subtitle lines are also loosely spaced, and 'HARRY LEE HOFFMAN' sits almost on the bottom edge.
